page_title: CRY 4-1 AST | Crystal Palace v Aston Villa 25/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' Aston Villa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+6' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
90+6' A cross from a corner kick by Aston Villa is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
90+6' The resulting set piece from Aston Villa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+1' 4 - 1 Tyrick Mitchell produces a sweet pass and picks out Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 4:1!
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
87' What was Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
86' A substitution has been made. Ismaila Sarr goes off and Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace) comes on.
86' Crystal Palace couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Robin Olsen (Aston Villa) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
85' Poor challenge! Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is penalised for tripping and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle.
84' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Crystal Palace was in an offside position.
82' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) has tested the patience of referee Samuel Barrott and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
81' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
81' Aston Villa are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
79' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
78' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ian Maatsen (Aston Villa) replacing Lucas Digne.
78' A substitution has been made. Adam Wharton is replaced by Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace).
76' Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
75' John McGinn (Aston Villa) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
74' Samuel Barrott sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
73' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Crystal Palace players aren’t happy.

71' 3 - 1 Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) gets to the ball on the edge of the box and fires in a first-time shot without any hesitation. The strike is excellent and goes straight into the bottom left corner. He couldn't have done it any better. 3:1.
71' Axel Disasi (Aston Villa) makes a strong challenge and Samuel Barrott blows for a foul.
69' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
68' The ball is out of play and Aston Villa manage to earn a corner.
68' Substitution. Marco Asensio (Aston Villa) replaces Jacob Ramsey.
68' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Marcus Rashford (Aston Villa) replaces Ollie Watkins.
68' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
67' Marc Guehi (Crystal Palace) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Samuel Barrott signals.
66' A spell of possession for Aston Villa in an attempt to control the game.
65' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Aston Villa for a penalty. Play continues.
63' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) serves up a nice cross, but Robin Olsen punches the ball away.
59' 2 - 1 Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball inside the left post in trademark fashion.
59' The corner is swung in but Crystal Palace can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
58' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Will Hughes.
56' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
53' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
52' 1 - 1 Goal! Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) finds some space for a shot from the edge of the box and his attempt goes low inside the right post. Fantastic finish.
51' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that crashes into the defensive wall. The opposition's goalkeeper set it up perfectly.
49' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
48' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) unleashed a promising volley from the edge of the box, but he narrowly misses the target as his shot goes over the bar.
48' None of the Crystal Palace players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
47' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
46' Unai Emery makes a switch. Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) is coming on in place of Andres Garcia at the start of the second period.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Unai Emery gives a chance to Robin Olsen and Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
45+2' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Aston Villa due to an offside in the build-up play.
43' Wait! Referee Samuel Barrott has indicated he is going to review the Aston Villa goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
42' Goal - 1:1! Ollie Watkins laid the ball off to Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
41' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
40' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post.
39' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) is penalised for a foul. Samuel Barrott had a clear view and blows his whistle.
39' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.

38' What an opportunity! Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the middle of the goal, but Emiliano Martinez reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
37' Aston Villa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
37' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
36' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
35' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
33' Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Samuel Barrott sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
30' The Crystal Palace players halt their celebrations as referee Samuel Barrott makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
29' 1 - 0 Goal! The rebound fell to Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) and he fired home from close range. The score is 1:0.
29' Emiliano Martinez makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom right corner by Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) after a cross from the side.
29' The linesman points to the corner flag, Crystal Palace are going to take it.
28' Aston Villa hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
26' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) has a goal ruled out for offside!
25' Samuel Barrott blows his whistle after Will Hughes (Crystal Palace) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
24' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
23' 0:0 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
21' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header just wide of the left post!
19' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
18' Crystal Palace are ruled offside.
17' Lamare Bogarde (Aston Villa) makes a rough challenge and Samuel Barrott blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
10' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
9' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) offside.
9' Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) trips an opposition player and Samuel Barrott signals a foul.
7' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
5' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
4' The game is interrupted. John McGinn (Aston Villa) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
1' The Aston Villa players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
